units.source_text: 岛村头一次触到这么冰凉的头发，不觉吃了一惊。

en.t: Shimamura was startled; it was the first time he had touched hair so cold.

units.source_text: 他觉得也许这不是由于天气寒冷，而是这类头发本身就是这样的缘故，所以也就不由得定睛细细打量一番。

en.t: He thought perhaps it was not because of the cold weather, but because this kind of hair was naturally that way, so he could not help gazing at it closely.

units.source_text: 女子却在被炉支架上屈指数起数来，数个没完没了。

en.t: The woman, however, began counting on her fingers on the kotatsu frame, and kept on counting without end.
